resource.name: Economic Chicago
resource.description: This dataset contains selected variables from the 2023 ACS Community Survey aggregated by Chicago Community Area, with additional years to be added as available. Because census tracts and community area boundaries do not perfectly align, values are estimated based on tract overlap proportions. The total population represented is 2,647,621 compared to the ACS 2023 Chicago total of 2,664,452 (-0.632% difference). Hispanic or Latino individuals are counted both within their identified race category and separately, consistent with Census Bureau methodology, including a White Not Hispanic or Latino category. Supporting code and geographic resources are available through the City of Chicago GitHub repository and related boundary datasets.
